data.long_meaning: The name Acelin is derived from the French word 'acelin', meaning 'little' or 'small'. It is a diminutive form of the name Ace, which has its origins in the Latin word 'as' meaning 'one' or 'unique'. In Christian mythology, Acelin represents the humility and innocence of the child of God. The name Acelin carries the meaning “Small, little” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Acelin usually hope their child will grow to embody small, little and live with faith, good character and purpose.

in_latin.name: Acelin
in_latin.meaning: Nomen donum a Deo, simplex et integer
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen donum a Deo, simplex et integer, ex anglico Acelein, quod est compositum ex Acele et Lino, primo significans semplicem, secundo referens ad plantam Linum. Nomen hoc est coniunctum cum notionibus simplicitatis, puritatis et generositas, quae sunt characteres in Christo. In traditione Christiana, nomen Acelin est significans personam, qui est simpliciter et sinceramente devotus Domino suo
